title: Kim Nilsson - Cracking MtGox
summary: Kim Nilsson presents his investigation into how Mt. Gox was hacked and mismanaged, tracing the finances and the missing bitcoins. It was given at the 2017 Breaking Bitcoin meetup.
why: HN commenters call it one of the best, most unbiased explanations of what actually happened to Mt. Gox and its missing coins.

quote.text: One of the best summaries of the Mt Gox incident, as well as the fallout and subsequent investigations that I've watched.
